decision_basis: Processed CKLF1 C-terminal peptide activity with CCR4 binding, Gi/o-sensitive calcium and chemotaxis, and receptor internalization supports qualified-high relay/function evidence.
CNTN1/PTPRZ1 ectodomain structure and binding with PTPRZ deficiency-linked oligodendrocyte function support qualified-high complex relay/function evidence.
NB-3/CNTN6-triggered Notch1 cleavage, NICD translocation, DTX1 dependence, and oligodendrocyte differentiation function support qualified-high relay/function evidence.
Mature collagen-I/DDR2 binding and activation with JAK2-ERK1/2 and fibroblast MMP10/DDR1-expression function support qualified-high matrix relay evidence; isolated COL1A1 is not claimed.
